defects.defect: Conditional FlowTest row (Contact_Set_Loyalty_Tier_Boundaries) is included in the change set even though its feasibility (setting a read-only roll-up in the test record) is unknown; an inventory row that may be dropped weakens the change set.
defects.skill_gap: None exists: spec-format gives no rule for when a FlowTest row may be Conditional or should be replaced by manual verification.

defects.defect: Security section says users 'without View All Data-style access will not see' the new fields; in fact profiles that receive default FLS on deploy (for example System Administrator) will see them, and a System Administrator profile has Create/Edit on Loyalty_Transaction__c that the 'who can trigger' list omits.
defects.skill_gap: Partial: spec-format notes profiles are also a grant path, but no instruction requires listing profile grants alongside permission sets.
